// Define the tree structure
datatype Tree = Empty | Node(value: int, left: Tree, right: Tree)

// Predicate to check if a tree is a valid BST
predicate IsBST(tree: Tree, min: int, max: int)
  decreases tree
{
  match tree
  case Empty => true
  case Node(v, l, r) =>
    min <= v < max &&
    IsBST(l, min, v) &&
    IsBST(r, v, max)
}

// Function to check if a tree is a valid BST (public wrapper)

{

}

// Predicate to check if a value exists in the tree
predicate Contains(tree: Tree, x: int)
  decreases tree
{
  match tree
  case Empty => false
  case Node(v, l, r) =>
    x == v || (x < v && Contains(l, x)) || (x > v && Contains(r, x))
}

// Function to insert a value into a BST

  ensures IsValidBST(t)
  ensures Contains(t, x)
  ensures forall y :: Contains(tree, y) ==> Contains(t, y)
